models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.variant: Mythos-class model with safeguards; classifier fallback to Opus 4.8 on cyber/bio-chem/distillation topics (<5% of sessions affected)

pricing.note: 发布文记为低于 Mythos Preview 一半以上；订阅内含资格随时间调整

models.capability_summary: Anthropic 以「Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Mythos 5」联合公告发布 Fable 5：一款带安全护栏的 Mythos 级模型，在网络安全/生物化学/蒸馏话题上按分类器回退到 Opus 4.8（影响 <5% 会话）。评测覆盖智能体编码、知识工作、计算机使用与生物安全，亮点如 SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%、OSWorld-Verified 85.0%。

models.name: Claude Mythos 5
models.variant: same underlying model, safeguards lifted in specific areas; restricted to Project Glasswing partners and upcoming trusted-access programs
models.capability_summary: 同公告中的 Claude Mythos 5 为与 Fable 5 同源的模型，在特定领域解除安全护栏，仅向 Project Glasswing 合作伙伴与后续可信访问计划开放，并报告药物设计环节约 10 倍加速等科研结果。评测与 Fable 5 共表（两模型分差 1–3 个百分点、取较高值），亮点如 Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.0%、GDPval-AA 1932 Elo。

notes: Release date 2026-06-09 from the newsroom index "Jun 9, 2026 - Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5" (joint announcement); OpenRouter created 2026-06-09 matches. DEPLOYMENT TIMELINE (page-top updates): access suspended Jun 12, 2026 (US government directive per the Jun 12 statement), redeployed Jul 1, 2026; subsequent posts cover cyber safeguards/jailbreak framework (Jul 2) and biology-safeguard improvements (Aug 7). Safeguard evidence: >95% of Fable sessions involve no fallback; external bug bounty (1000+ hours) found no universal jailbreaks, UK AISI made progress toward one in a brief window; partner test: zero compliance on harmful single-turn cyber requests across 30 public jailbreak techniques. Science (Mythos 5, notes only): ~10x acceleration on aspects of drug design, 9/14 protein targets yielded strong candidates; AAV shell-assembly prediction beat dedicated protein language models (Dyno Therapeutics candidates); genomics model 100x smaller beat a recent Science-published model; scientists preferred Mythos molecular-biology hypotheses ~80% of the time in blinded comparisons. Other notes: Slay the Spire file-memory improved performance 3x more than for Opus 4.8; Pokemon FireRed beaten with vision-only harness; 30-day data retention for Mythos-class traffic; pricing USD 10/50 per MTok (less than half of Mythos Preview); subscription rollout staging (included through Jun 22, removed Jun 23, later restored). Table values image-only (pending); starred rows are safeguard-affected for Fable (falls back toward Opus 4.8). 2026-09-01 audit：live 页总表（1e659824…-2600x2870，列 Mythos 5/Fable 5 合并列）逐格复核，16 行数值全部一致；表格 13 个评测项全覆盖（HLE 与 BioMysteryBench 各拆 2 行）无缺漏。跨页差异备案：Opus 5 页 Fable 5 列 HLE 56.5/63.9 与本页 59.0*/64.5* 不同——本页带 * 号且 methodology 注明 Mythos/Fable 取两者较高分、* 行受生物/网络安全拦截护栏影响，两页口径不同，各自如实记录。
